comuneros-revolt-new-granada.description: A dramatic painted crowd of rural, mostly dark-skinned peasants marches up a stony mountain path under a stormy sky. A central man in a dark ragged poncho and wide-brimmed hat raises a long spear and holds a machete. Behind him, hundreds more carry pikes, machetes and a few muskets, with women in long skirts and straw hats. A colonial-style town with a church sits in the valley below. Era cues are pre-industrial: straw hats, ponchos, linen shirts, spears and muskets. No text, no frame, no blood.

inconfidencia-mineira-plot.description: A candlelit room with rough plank walls and shutters. Five or six men in dark 18th-century coats and waistcoats crowd around a wooden table covered in maps, folded letters, a quill, an inkwell and a pocket watch. A bearded older man in the centre leans over the map, and a younger man in a maroon coat gestures. Another man on the left seated at the table writes. The scribbled papers show no legible text. Painted oil style, filling the whole frame.

narino-prints-rights-of-man.description: A dark-haired man in a waistcoat and rolled white sleeves leans over a wooden screw press in a dim brick back room, lit by a small lantern. Crates, paper stacks and inkwells fill the room, and a stack of printed sheets sits at lower right with illegible painterly marks. No frame, border or signature, and nothing graphic.

gual-espana-conspiracy.description: An interior of a dim, wood-beamed room with a lit lantern on a table. Around the table sit several men of mixed complexions, some holding papers and a quill, with a few more standing behind them. At the left, uniformed soldiers in tricorn hats and white cross-belts with bayonets push through an open door, one raising a sabre. Through the open window at right, moonlit water shows sailing ships at anchor and distant hills. No visible text.
